name: Platt's Lane Estates townhouses, 492–502
summary: Six two-storey red brick townhouses form three offset pairs with southern entries and a lawn-side rear. Shallow brown gables sit between light dividing walls.

evidence.note: Three pairs on a stepped footprint with southern paths and parking, with a muted grey-brown roof colour from a 7 by 7 pixel sample in 2025 aerial-source.jpg centered at (282, 199) measuring #6f6254.
Regional-2m LiDAR gives a P50 of 6.63 m, P90 of 7.08 m, and maximum of 8.55 m, indicating a two-storey townhouse roofline near 7.1 m with a modest upper outlier possibly from trees or roof vents.
The City's geocoded address points confirm the street addresses and two-storey height for the townhouse rows.
Western Facilities Management estate aerial photograph.
Western Housing, 1976 walk-up apartment and townhouse development.
Townhouse material samples measure red brick under overcast daylight in frame 46920571 at (36.0%, 41.1%) as #714239 and sunlit buff panel in frame 148668881 at (65.2%, 64.3%) as #d8c09c.
Comparable photographed adjacent townhouse rows on the estate supply details for unseen walls, estimated door and window bay sizes, and entry canopy and ledge materials.
No clear direct street view is available for this building.
Frames 46920572 and 148668879 show estate townhouses with two broad windows per pair per storey, pale painted single doors, thin window sills, and raised cream-capped end and dividing walls.
City of London building footprint verified against 2025 aerial imagery to trace townhouse pairs, stepped party walls, and entry approaches, with exact door positions estimated within each pair.
Western Housing shows a rear kitchen window, a separate dining-room patio door and projecting privacy walls. The three-bedroom plan also shows a single exterior kitchen door.
The 1 m return grid supplies two roof slopes and a ground-plan alignment correction of +0.5 m east and +1.0 m south.

notes: The upper front windows sit over red panels beside the projecting buff firewalls. Exact rear door handing, privacy-screen lengths and the joints in the raised end panels vary by unit.
